pages.title: Tax and Employee Share Schemes: Share Incentive Plans (SIPs)
Tax and Employee Share Schemes: Overview

who.statement: employees whose employer offers its company's shares through such a plan

source.title: Tax and Employee Share Schemes: Overview
source.quote: Your employer may offer you company shares as a reward for working for them.

source.title: Tax and Employee Share Schemes: Share Incentive Plans (SIPs)
source.quote: Your employer can give you up to 2 free matching shares for each partnership share you buy.

employer_match.notes: Free matching shares for each partnership share the employee buys out of salary before tax. The page adds free shares of up to £3,600 a tax year.

income_tax.value: no Income Tax or National Insurance on the value of shares kept in the plan for 5 years

source.title: Tax and Employee Share Schemes: Share Incentive Plans (SIPs)
source.quote: keep them in the plan for 5 years you will not pay Income Tax or National Insurance on their value.

source.title: Tax and Employee Share Schemes: Share Incentive Plans (SIPs)
source.quote: keep them in the plan for 5 years you will not pay Income Tax or National Insurance on their value.

keep_years.notes: How long shares stay in the plan for the exemption. The page does not say the shares are locked for that time.

countries.looked_for: A savings product that both the employer and the employee pay into, that opens after a few years and is not meant for retirement, on the IRS's and the federal government's pages. Not finding one is no proof there is none.

who.statement: the employees of a company that has set up a PEE; the plan must be open to all of them, after at most 3 months of seniority

source.title: Plan d'épargne entreprise (PEE) (vérifié le 1er janvier 2026)
source.locator: Qui est concerné par le PEE ?
source.quote: Si l'entreprise a mis en place un PEE, il doit être ouvert à tous les salariés.

source.title: Plan d'épargne entreprise (PEE) (vérifié le 1er janvier 2026)
source.quote: L'abondement ne peut pas dépasser 3 fois le montant versé par le salarié, ni être supérieur à 3 844,8 €

employer_match.notes: The employer's addition (abondement) at most, as the page prints it, verified on 1 January 2026. The same page raises the employer's ceiling to 7,689.6 euro where its payments buy its own shares, and the income tax exemption to 6,920.64 euro where the employee invests in them.

source.title: Plan d'épargne entreprise (PEE) (vérifié le 1er janvier 2026)
source.quote: L'abondement ne peut pas dépasser 3 fois le montant versé par le salarié, ni être supérieur à 3 844,8 €

income_tax.value: the employer's addition is exempt from income tax for the employee, up to 3,844.8 euro

source.title: Plan d'épargne entreprise (PEE) (vérifié le 1er janvier 2026)
source.locator: Quelle est la fiscalité du PEE ? Abondement versé par l'entreprise
source.quote: versé par l'entreprise est exonéré d'impôt sur le revenu pour le salarié, dans la limite de 3 844,8 €

income_tax.notes: The addition is subject to CSG and CRDS (same page).

source.title: Plan d'épargne entreprise (PEE) (vérifié le 1er janvier 2026)
source.locator: Les sommes versées sur le PEE sont-elles disponibles ?
source.quote: Les sommes investies dans le PEE sont bloquées pendant au moins 5 ans

early_release.value: early release in listed cases, among them buying or enlarging the main home

source.title: Plan d'épargne entreprise (PEE) (vérifié le 1er janvier 2026)
source.locator: Les sommes versées sur le PEE sont-elles disponibles ?
source.quote: Toutefois, le salarié peut demander le déblocage anticipé des sommes dans certains cas.

early_release.notes: The cases listed include 'Acquisition ou agrandissement de la résidence principale, avec création de nouvelle surface habitable'.

countries.looked_for: A savings product that both the employer and the employee pay into, that opens after a few years and is not meant for retirement, on the Italian government's, tax authority's and pension regulator's pages. Not finding one is no proof there is none.
